title: Yellowed Silky Portuguese Beef Flank Steak Roast
description: This dish features a tender beef flank steak roast with a rich umami flavor, served with a silky sauce, perfect for a festive Portuguese dinner. The gluten-free friendly ingredients make it accessible to a wide range of diners.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef flank steak with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Seal the beef flank steak for 2-3 minutes per side, then set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the port wine, beef broth, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the beef flank steak to the pot and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 2.5 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
